The '''MZX32905 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="b">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref> It was located in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]],<ref name="i">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref> near [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]] and [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]].<ref name="b" /> The system contained an [[asteroid field]] that itself contained [[The Home]]&mdash;an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] home to first [[Darth Vectivus]], and later [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]].
